_readme: Weekly working list of sailings. Add one object per sailing to "sailings". Fields: loadPort, destination, vessel, voyage, carrier, ets (departure), eta (arrival), lane, notes. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD. Transit time is calculated from ets/eta, do not enter it. Rows with "example": true are demo rows - delete them once real sailings are in. Bump "updated" whenever you refresh the list. "lanes" is the carrier lane directory used for the reference links lower down the page.

source.name: Carrier schedules
source.note: Compiled from published carrier schedules — NMT Shipping, Wallenius Wilhelmsen, "K" Line, NYK RoRo, Grimaldi, Sallaum Lines, Höegh Autoliners and Geest Line — plus a residue from Autoshippers where the arrival is derived from a published transit time rather than confirmed by the carrier. Some sailings tranship en route, and where a carrier publishes only an arrival at the load port the departure will be later than the date shown. All dates are carrier estimates and must be reconfirmed before a booking is committed.
